overview: Bolstering The Falcon Dominator Plus range of Induction cooking equipment is the heavy duty E3917i Solid Top Induction range.

With Induction technology becoming ever more popular due to not only it's incredible energy efficiency but also safety and ease of use, the E3917i hits the mark for chefs and owners looking to add a solid top oven to their kitchen. Traditional gas solid tops give the end user unrivalled flexibility due to the concentric gas burners that radiate heat outwards.. Hotter in the middle, cooler at the edges. Simple stuff.

overview: The E402F Programmable Electric Fryer with Filtration from Falcon is an ideal choice for chefs who want a high-output fryer that is efficient and does not compromise on quality. The use of a high efficiency tri-stack element system provide a fast heat-up time and instant recovery, whilst also reducing energy consumption. A smaller fry vat requires 40% less oil to fill than a standard 50 lb fryer, while maintaining the overall cooking capacity.
The Oil Guardian™ system monitors oil levels and automatically replenishes oil from a reservoir inside the fryer cabinet, eliminating manual add-backs and frequent oil disposal.
Smart Touch Filtration™ improves oil savings, product quality and employee productivity by filtering individual vats at the touch of a button, while allowing other vats to cook uninterrupted.
Filter system drains oil, rinses away crumbs and returns hot filtered oil to the vat in less than four minutes! No handles, valves or anything else to pull open or close.

iControl™ provides a simple, intuitive interface that lets you store 40 cook programs and offers a host of features, like idle and melt modes, load compensation, filter tracking, multiple language settings, USB support, and more.
